title: Chronicle Android Raw Data Preprocessing App
description: Browser-based preprocessing instrument for Chronicle Android usage-events data. A single Rust engine compiled to WebAssembly runs entirely in the user's browser and reconstructs app-usage and screen-usage sessions under a versioned configuration contract, with golden-scenario output locking and per-run PROV provenance sidecars. Includes the LinkML/OWL/SHACL research ontology generated from the same source of truth.
